name: Hagi
source:
Man who is a servant. He lives at a lodging house in the royal palace.
He is the oldest of the servants and like a father to them.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092288.html]DLsite English[/url]]
